info.description:
Personal AI athletic training coach — chat-first, self-hosted.
The current athlete is resolved server-side (personal-first MVP); requests need no authentication headers yet.
info.title: vcoach API

get.description: The athlete's coaching conversations, newest first.
Message history of one chat session, oldest first.

post.description: Streams the coach reply as Server-Sent Events: "delta" events carry final-answer tokens, "done" carries the persisted message ID, "error" carries a failure. The coach may create goals and plans via tool calls during the turn.
post.summary: Send a message to the coach

get.description: Manual climbing log entries in the inclusive date range.

post.description: Boulder and lead grades use the Font scale (e.g. 6B, 7A boulder; 6a, 7a+ lead). Hardest sent cannot be harder than hardest attempted.

put.description: Partial update; grades are re-validated after merging with the stored session.

get.description: All goals of the athlete, newest first.

post.description: Catalog-validated goal (run events in km, boulder and lead goals as Font grades). Setting isPrimary clears other active goals.

patch.description: Partial update of status, primary flag and notes. Setting isPrimary clears other active goals.

get.description: Progress facts for one goal: run goals (longest run 30d, best pace, weekly volumes) or climb goals (hardest sent 30d, rank gap to target, attempts).
All plan versions of the athlete, newest version first.

post.description: Creates the next plan version and archives the current active one atomically. Weeks need consecutive weekNumbers starting at 1; sessions carry YYYY-MM-DD planned dates.

get.description: One plan version with weeks, sessions and per-session compliance.

delete.description: Archives a plan version (e.g. before regenerating via chat).

get.description: Manual basics plus metrics derived from synced Garmin data (HR zones, VO2max, weekly volumes, longest run, weight trend).

put.description: Updates manual profile basics; nil fields are kept.

post.description: Pulls activities and daily health since the cursor (90-day backfill on first sync) and applies compliance matching. Returns per-run counts and any per-source errors.

get.description: Per-source sync state: last synced time, cursor and last error (e.g. an expired Garmin API key).
